notes:
Eight spatial layer of Syria power line and generator and power plant and substation.
Two spatial layer of Syria Natural Water and waterway dam.
Four spatial layer of Syria highway /motorway / link /primary / trunk.

organization.description: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs in Syria.
